# Android HTTP transport

OkHttp 5.3.2 and Okio 3.16.4, Copyright Square, Inc. and contributors.
Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE). Maven coordinates are pinned in the Android build.
Sources: https://github.com/square/okhttp/tree/parent-5.3.2 and
https://github.com/square/okio/tree/parent-3.16.4 .
Mesting keeps system DNS/proxy/certificate trust, races IPv4/IPv6 connections
before dispatch, and disables automatic request replay.
